test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 08 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the bracketed segment in the given sentence. If there is no need to substitute it, select 'no substitution required'.

(Democrats control neither Congress and neither the White House, but) they are doing their best to control the judicial processes.

options.text: Democrats control neither Congress or the White House, but
Democrat controls neither Congress and nor the White House, though
Democrats control neither Congress nor the White House, but

solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 4'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error in the sentence is in the bracketed segment. The correct conjunction to use with **"neither"** is **"nor."**
 
• The correct phrase should be *"Democrats control neither Congress nor the White House, but..."*
 
• Option 4 correctly replaces **"and neither"** with **"nor."**
 
• The rest of the sentence is grammatically correct.

Therefore, the** correct sentence** is: *'**Democrats control neither Congress nor the White House, but they are doing their best to control the judicial processes.'*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1** is incorrect because it uses "or" instead of "nor."
 
• **Option 2 **is incorrect because it changes the subject to "Democrat" (singular) and uses "and nor," which is not grammatically correct.
